easter-egg:1.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:1.text: In the datapoint VIP Key!, the names Hans and Elise were chosen by Senior Game Designer Daniel Wewerinke, as they are the names of his parents. Additionally, the code 2204, given in this datapoint, is a reference to his mother's birthday. Codes used in other ruins were similarly derived from the birthdates of Wewerinke's family members.

easter-egg:2.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:2.text: Within Rebel Camp: First Forge, a derailed mine cart can be found surrounded by bananas and barrels - one containing a red baseball cap - referencing Donkey Kong Country.

easter-egg:3.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:3.text: The names of the 4 optional Cauldrons (MU, IOTA, CHI, and KAPPA) spell out the acronym "MICK" when ordered by ascending difficulty level. World designer Dennis Micka chose these names to spell out his surname, Micka, but a fifth planned cauldron (presumably named ALPHA) was removed from the game during development, leaving the acronym incomplete.

easter-egg:4.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:4.text: Southeast of Riverhymn, a sword can be found protruding from a stone, referencing the mythical Excalibur of Arthurian legend.

easter-egg:5.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:5.text: Southwest of Thornmarsh, an invincible Red Fox can be found which will lead the player towards a shrine in the form of a fox sculpture. This is a reference to the Inari shrines found in Ghost of Tsushima.

easter-egg:6.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:6.text: The War Totem collectables each reference characters from the 2018 God of War, and are found in locations referencing the main characters of the game.

easter-egg:7.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:7.text: Inside LATOPOLIS, a rack can be found filled with guns resembling the LSR44 Spoor, the primary weapon used throughout the Killzone Shadow Fall campaign.

easter-egg:8.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:8.text: In Cauldrons MU, IOTA, CHI, and KAPPA, sealed doors can be found with Triforce symbols above them. These doors can be opened by pressing the sequence for Zelda's Lullaby (◀▲▶◀▲▶) on the controller's D-pad, each leading to a small room with additional loot. Upon opening the door, Aloy's dialogue contains the phrases "hey, listen" and "it's dangerous to go alone", both notable quotations from the Zelda series.

easter-egg:9.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:9.text: To the northwest of Thornmarsh, on an island connected to the mainland by a sandbar, a memorial can be found honoring Patrick Munnik, lead producer of Horizon Zero Dawn. Upon reaching the memorial site, Aloy will sit on a woven mat with a scenic view of the Isle of Spires and read from a note eulogizing a deceased friend.

easter-egg:10.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:10.text: In the Relic Ruins at Restless Weald, a tiny artwork of the Guerilla Games logo can be found next to an image of a heart and the Ukrainian flag, on a railcar.

easter-egg:11.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
